The test image shows a tomato leaf with yellowish-green mottling/patches and what appears to be a dusty/powdery texture on the upper surface. This is a leaf, so my candidates are the 13 leaf-affecting classes.

Top candidates: Powdery_Mildew, Leaf_Mold, Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus. Let me view references one at a time.
Powdery Mildew reference shows white dusty coating on green leaf. The test image has more of a yellow-green mottled appearance. Let me check Leaf_Mold.
Leaf Mold reference shows discrete yellowish spots on a pale leaf. The test image pattern is more diffuse. Let me check Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus.
CMV shows severely distorted/curled leaves - very different from the test image's normal-shaped leaf. Let me check Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus.
TSWV shows concentric ring patterns and necrotic spots - not matching the test image's diffuse yellowing. Let me check another Powdery_Mildew reference.
This Powdery Mildew shows distinct white spots on green leaves. The test image seems more uniformly yellowed/mottled. Let me check another Leaf_Mold reference.
This Leaf Mold reference (CDDM_3196) looks very similar to the test image - dark green leaf with irregular yellowish-green patches, diffuse chlorosis. Let me check Early_Blight to compare.
Early Blight shows distinct dark brown target lesions - very different from the test image. Let me check Septoria_Leaf_Blotch.

Septoria shows many small distinct circular spots - very different from the test image.

**Summary of comparisons:**
- **Leaf_Mold (CDDM_3196)**: Closest match - dark green leaf with irregular diffuse yellowish-green patches, similar leaf shape and background
- **Powdery_Mildew**: Shows white powdery spots, not the diffuse yellow-green mottling seen in test image
- **Early_Blight**: Has concentric brown target lesions - not present
- **Septoria**: Many small discrete spots - not present
- **TSWV**: Ring-spot patterns with necrotic spots - not present
- **CMV**: Severely distorted/curled leaves - not present

The test image shows a dark green tomato leaf with irregular diffuse yellow-green chlorotic patches, no distinct lesions or spots. This matches Leaf Mold's characteristic "pale greenish-yellow spots on the upper leaf surface" with brighter yellow indistinct chlorosis.
